title: StepResult
description: Result of executing a single plan step.

step_number.description: Which plan step this result corresponds to.

files_changed.description: List of files that were modified. For Codex results, this is reconstructed from git diff by the orchestrator.

summary.description: Overall summary of what was implemented.

issues.description: Known issues or caveats with this implementation.

test_commands.description: Shell commands to verify this step works correctly.

workspace_diffs.description: Optional per-repo git diffs captured for workspace-mode runs.

path.description: Relative file path. Must not contain .. segments or start with /.

summary.description: One-line description of what changed in this file.
